title: Conormal sheaf of a closed immersion under (flat) base change
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$, $i':Z'\to X'$, $g:X\to X'$, $f:Z\to Z'$ be as in [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial] ($i,i'$ closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], $g\circ i=i'\circ f$), with canonical map $c:f^*\mathcal C_{Z'/X'}\to\mathcal C_{Z/X}$ of conormal sheaves. Assume the square is cartesian, i.e. $(Z,i,f)$ is a fibre product of $g$ and $i'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $c$ is surjective; if moreover $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], then $c$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules. (Affine locally: for a ring map $R'\to R$ and an ideal $I'\subset R'$ with $I=I'R$, the map $I'/I'^2\otimes_{R'}R\to I/I^2$ is surjective, and bijective when $R'\to R$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].)

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), case of closed immersions, with its proof; the ideal of the base-changed closed immersion is Schemes, Lemma 01JU (schemes-lemma-fibre-product-immersion) (1)

proof.text: The map $c$ is the canonical conormal map constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial], since the commutative square of closed immersions is part of the hypotheses.

Fix $z\in Z$. Choose affine opens $U'=\operatorname{Spec}R'\subseteq X'$ containing $g(i(z))$ and $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq g^{-1}(U')$ containing $i(z)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-affine-cover-criterion] write $i'^{-1}(U')=\operatorname{Spec}(R'/I')$. The cartesian square restricted to $U$ remains cartesian [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product], [lem-weil-pbc-cartesian-square-pasting]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-quotient-base-change-closed-immersion-ideal] to $U\to U'$ and $I'$, obtaining $i^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$ and the ideal $I=I'R$. On these charts [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-affine-sections] identifies the source of $c$ with $(I'/I'^2)\otimes_{R'}R$, and the affine characterization in [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial] identifies $c$ with the map induced by $R'\to R$ into $I/I^2$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), affine reduction; Schemes, Lemma 01JU (schemes-lemma-fibre-product-immersion) (1)

proof.text: For each chart of the preceding step, [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-cotangent-flat-base-change-ring] makes the module map $(I'/I'^2)\otimes_{R'}R\to I/I^2$ surjective. If $g$ is flat, [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-affine-criterion] makes $R'\to R$ flat, so the same ring result makes the map bijective. These charts cover $Z$. The source and target of $c$ are quasi-coherent, and their affine sections have the displayed descriptions [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent], [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial]. For surjectivity, the cokernel has zero sections on every such chart by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image] (3), hence is the zero sheaf because the charts cover $Z$; thus $c$ is an epimorphism. In the flat case the restrictions of $c$ on these charts are isomorphisms: each is a map of quasi-coherent modules induced by a bijection on affine sections [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] (3). Hence $c$ is globally an isomorphism by [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-morphism-on-basis] (b).
